info.description: Bounded simulator subset of the official Amazon Redshift API (2012-12-01). Every other official operation returns HTTP 501 UnknownOperationException. Cluster parameter groups and cluster subnet groups are stored configuration served over the Query protocol: no cluster, snapshot, node, endpoint, data share, integration or warehouse exists, and CreateCluster, CreateClusterSnapshot, RestoreFromClusterSnapshot and every other official operation return UnknownOperationException with HTTP 501. Snapshot schedules, scheduled actions, usage limits, event subscriptions, HSM certificates and configurations, snapshot copy grants, authentication profiles and cluster security groups are not implemented: they need a cluster, a topic, a key, an IAM role or a schedule grammar the stored model cannot evaluate, so their APIs return UnknownOperationException with HTTP 501. Parameter values are not modeled: ModifyClusterParameterGroup, ResetClusterParameterGroup, DescribeClusterParameters and DescribeDefaultClusterParameters are not implemented, and default parameter groups and the default subnet group are not pre-created. A parameter group family is stored without checking that it exists. Parameter group names are 1 to 255 letters, digits or hyphens, start with a letter, contain no trailing or consecutive hyphens and are stored in lowercase. A subnet group needs 1 to 20 distinct subnet-xxxxxxxx or subnet-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx IDs that are not resolved, so it reports no VPC, Availability Zone, subnet status, group status or supported IP address type; the 20-subnet limit is returned as ClusterSubnetQuotaExceededFault. Subnet group names are 1 to 255 letters, digits or hyphens, are stored in lowercase and must not be Default. Describe operations refuse TagKeys, TagValues and Marker values that were not issued for the request, accept MaxRecords from 20 to 100 and fail with the operation's not-found fault for an unknown name. Resource counts per Region (50 parameter groups and 50 subnet groups) are local limits. CreateTags and DeleteTags apply to the two resource kinds by ARN (arn:aws:redshift:region:account:parametergroup:name and subnetgroup:name) and fail with ResourceNotFoundFault for any other ARN; tags appear on the group descriptions. Tag keys are required and must not start with aws:. Removing a missing key succeeds, and DescribeTags is not implemented.
